messages:
leah: Heads-up: PR #2145 renamed dashboard panel field `agg` -> `aggregation_method` to be explicit. Unfortunately our docs examples (panels JSON) and generated SDK snippets still use `agg` so example generation fails in CI.

omar: saw the CI error this morning. Which pages are impacted?

leah: console/observability/dashboards.md, examples/dashboard/response_time_panel.json, quickstarts/latency-and-cost.md, and generated snippets that embed the panel config.

prasanna: quick mitigation: docs hotfix to update examples and add a short migration note. but we should also consider a short-lived backend alias that accepts `agg` and maps to `aggregation_method` so saved dashboards don’t break.

ci-bot: docs CI failure: example generation error: unknown property `agg` in panel schema. https://ci.redwood/inference/2145/build/6

docs-bot: lint: broken anchor detected in dashboards.md pointing to #panel-aggregation. Suggest using #panel-aggregation-method redirect.

omar: plan: (1) prasanna opens docs PR that replaces `agg` with `aggregation_method` in examples and adds a Migration block with a one-line jq converter; (2) leah files a backend PR to accept both keys for 30 days and surface a deprecation warning in the console; (3) regenerate snippets; (4) monitor canary for 60 minutes.

prasanna: drafting migration text now. will include explicit example and conversion command: 

```
# old panel (deprecated)
"panels": [
  {"title": "p50 latency", "agg": "p50", "metric": "latency_ms"}
]

# new panel
"panels": [
  {"title": "p50 latency", "aggregation_method": "p50", "metric": "latency_ms"}
]

# quick converter (jq)
jq '(.. | objects | select(has("agg")) ) |= (. + {"aggregation_method": .agg} | del(.agg))' old_dashboard.json > new_dashboard.json
```

leah: yes, add a short note: "aggregation_method expects values like `avg`, `p50`, `p90`, `p99`. Values are strings." and call out that the field is now snake_case to match other panel keys.

omar: I'll open the backend PR for an alias with UI warning. Warning text: "`agg` is deprecated, use `aggregation_method` (supported values: avg, p50, p90, p99). This alias will be removed on YYYY-MM-DD."

ci-bot: backend PR 342 opened by omar: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/342  adds alias + warning banner in canary.

prasanna: docs PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2156  updates examples, migration block, and fixes anchors. Requesting leah for review. Also added a crosslink to SDK snippets so reviewers can check generated code.

docs-bot: docs PR 2156: anchor redirect added at /_redirects for old #panel-aggregation -> #panel-aggregation-method. Linkcheck passed locally.

leah: once PRs are merged: sequence -> merge docs PR, run snippet generation, merge backend alias PR to canary, smoke test playground dashboards for 1 hour, then promote. Any objections?

omar: +1. I'll monitor console logs for deprecation warnings and collect metrics on frequency of `agg` usage so we know when to remove alias.

prasanna: assigning tasks: prasanna -> docs edits + jq snippet, leah -> snippet regen + canary QA, omar -> backend alias + deprecation banner, ci-bot -> run CI checks and post results. I'll also file an issue to add a docs CI lint to detect deprecated keys in examples (so this doesn't slip again).
